parole.significato: To reserve (a place), such as a seat in a fast food restaurant, sometimes by placing a packet of tissue paper on it.
parole.testo: From Malay chup (“a cry in a game requesting a halt or the retraction of a stroke”), possibly from Hindi चुप (cup, “silence!”).

parole.significato: A type of yeast traditionally used in winemaking, baking, and brewing, now identified as Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
parole.testo: From Malay ragi (“fermenting medium, yeast”), from an Indian language such as Hindi रागी (rāgī, “finger millet”), since finger millet can be fermented. See Etymology 1.
